The maximum operating temperature of Unit A is 180°C. This limit was established
during the original commissioning in 2019. Operating above this temperature for
more than 15 minutes requires an emergency shutdown and a mandatory inspection
by the site reliability team before restart. The temperature is measured by
thermocouple TC-A-001 located at the exhaust manifold. Calibration of TC-A-001
must be performed quarterly according to SOP-TEMP-042.

Unit A is a centrifugal compressor rated for continuous duty at 3,600 RPM with
a maximum discharge pressure of 42 bar. The lubrication system uses ISO VG 68
synthetic turbine oil with a recommended change interval of 8,000 operating
hours or 12 months, whichever comes first.
